summary: This is an 8-K filed by Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Securities, Inc., as depositor for Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Trust 2018-C47, reporting a routine servicing transfer for the Christiana Mall Mortgage Loan, which constitutes about 5.3% of the trust's asset pool. The special servicer was changed from Trimont LLC to Green Loan Services LLC under the BBCMS 2018-CHRS trust and servicing agreement, effective July 14, 2026. No financial terms, premium, or board recommendation are provided. The filing is a standard operational update with no special-situation implications or risk-arb angle.
